name: 32163 · The Villages, FL
findings: ZIP 32163 (The Villages) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32163 (The Villages) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32163 (The Villages) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
